svg.title: Full deployment architecture for brain tumor XAI app
svg.desc: Three-layer architecture: user browser talks to Next.js on Vercel, which authenticates via Supabase and calls FastAPI on HuggingFace Spaces ZeroGPU for ML inference and XAI.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What pages does the doctor dashboard have?')
sendPrompt('What pages does the patient dashboard have?')
sendPrompt('How does NextAuth.js handle doctor vs patient roles?')
sendPrompt('What does Next.js middleware do for role-based routing?')
sendPrompt('What do the Next.js API routes do?')
sendPrompt('What are the doctor dashboard pages?')
sendPrompt('What are the patient dashboard pages?')
sendPrompt('What does the shared UI component library include?')
sendPrompt('What does Supabase auth handle in this project?')
sendPrompt('What columns does the users table need?')
sendPrompt('What columns does the scans table need?')
sendPrompt('What FastAPI endpoints do I need to build?')
sendPrompt('How do I load best_resnet101.pth in FastAPI on HuggingFace?')
sendPrompt('How do I expose Grad-CAM, SHAP and LIME as API endpoints?')

svg.text: Click any box to ask Claude about it
